values.note: Both the forest's page and the booking page's alert say there is no water or electric; 14 of the 19 ReserveAmerica site pages nevertheless list 'Electricity Hookup: 30/50' and 'Water Hookup: Y' (and 'NON Potable water'), which looks like a copied template.

values.note: 19 'RV or Tent' sites, all back-in: 13 take vehicles to 24 ft, 6 to 36 ft.

sites.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/high-bluff-campground-lake-talquin-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120121 (19 sites found; each site's Max Vehicle Length and Access Type: Back-In), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/high-bluff-campground-lake-talquin-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120121 ('Facilities: Fishing pier, boat ramp, vaulted restroom', amenity 'Toilet, Pit/Vault'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Florida Forest Service campground on its own ReserveAmerica site (or 1-877-879-3859): 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance' (window shown Oct 21 2026 to Sep 21 2027). All sites are site-specific; check-in 3 pm, check-out 1 pm.

booking.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/high-bluff-campground-lake-talquin-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120121 (Booking Window; site details 'Site-Specific', 'Checkin Time: 3:00 pm', 'Checkout Time: 1:00 pm'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The Florida Forest Service offers camping discounts for people 65 and older, active-duty military or honorably discharged veterans, and the 100% disabled 'at applicable camping facilities'; documentation is registered by calling (877) 879-3859.

discounts.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/high-bluff-campground-lake-talquin-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120121 ('The Florida Forest Service offers camping discounts for individuals age 65 and older, active-duty military or honorably discharged veterans, and for individuals 100% disabled at applicable camping facilities'), read 2026-10-21

note: Florida Forest Service campground on the north side of Lake Talquin, beside the Joe Budd Wildlife Management Area (a hunting area). Fishing pier and boat ramp. Horse camping is allowed if self-sufficient (tie out or bring a portable corral). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the FFS ReserveAmerica page and FDACS: 19 back-in RV/tent sites (13 to 24 ft, 6 to 36 ft), primitive with no water or electric, vault restroom, open year-round, reservable same-day to 11 months ahead. Added season, booking window/url, the FFS military/veteran discount. Fees left (human-read 2026-10-12, $9.13). policy_ref is 'none' as expected. Note: dropped site count, hookups, toilet, booking and the stale '~$9-16/night'.
flags: ReserveAmerica site details for 14 of 19 High Bluff sites list 'Electricity Hookup: 30/50' and 'Water Hookup: Y', contradicting both the campground alert ('No water or electric available within the campground') and FDACS ('Primitive campsites with no electricity or water'); recorded as no hookups.
